justification: Inspected `jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileFactory.java` and `jimfs/src/test/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileFactoryTest.java`. `SymbolicLinkSupplier` is a private nested helper with only one field (`target`) and one behavior (`get()` delegates to `createSymbolicLink(target)`), so it is a thin callback rather than an under-decomposed class; the tests show it is used only as a supplier wrapper for one construction path.
